Produced by FIFTH SEASON and Chernin Entertainment, the show is led by showrunner Doug Jung, with Jason Momoa directing the finale and Justin Chon helming the first two episodes. Grammy and Oscar winner Hans Zimmer co‐composed the sweeping score with James Everingham for Bleeding Fingers Music, ensuring a powerful, indigenous-focused retelling of Hawaiian unification.
